title: Robotics Intern
description: Developed automated drone sensor calibration pipeline using 5-DOF robotic arm.

title: Mechatronics Engineering Researcher
company: Mechanical Systems Control Lab / UC Berkeley
description: Developed a syringe pump system with hydraulic and pneumatic actuation for soft robotic applications.
highlights: Built the low-level control stack on an ESP32 in C++ (Arduino IDE).
Designed, calibrated, and tested a pressure sensor circuit with amplifier and filter stages for reliable closed-loop feedback.
Programmed a PID pressure controller: roughly ±1 kPa precision (~1.0% span error) pneumatic and ±2 kPa (~0.75% span error) hydraulic.

title: Robotics Research Intern
description: Implemented and evaluated a vision-based approach for collaborative mapping between two robots (ROS2, Python).
highlights: Built two ROSBots and implemented follow-the-leader coordination using AprilTag detection and a PD controller for relative localization.
Chained frame transforms between adjacent AprilTags to merge both robots' maps into one.
Collaborative mapping beat individual mapping in accuracy: 2.05 m vs 2.69 m RMSE.
Presented results as a poster at the BU RISE symposium.
